meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why was Owen's zero entered before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Now tell me why there's a zero at all.

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. People draft in other programs and paste it in, so that's the history of one file. What else do you have?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Did you ask him for that draft before you entered the zero?
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Students misquote from memory, or lift a line from a critic and forget to cite it. That's a mistake in an essay, not proof of anything.
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Okay. I'll check the scene myself. Whatever comes of this, it stays off his record, and it stays quiet.
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and the final essay, that's called revising. Is that all this shows?

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
Okay. I'll take the rewrite to put this behind him, in writing tonight, with the date before December 1 and nothing on his file. What I think of the outline goes in my email.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday the twelfth, after school. Put the date in the email, and I'll tell you tonight if Owen has a conflict.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private supervised rewrite for Owen after school on Thursday the twelfth, before December 1, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed in his record. I still want that confirmed in writing, along with what I think of the outline comparison. I expect it tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and accepted a private supervised rewrite on Thursday the twelfth after school, before December 1, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record; she still wants it in writing tonight, and her objections about the outline are going in her email. That is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: You told her to search the Hamlet scene herself for the line in the essay, then answered her misquote defence by saying a misquote lands close to a real line and this one doesn't, which she could check and could not wave away.
What cost ground: Nothing.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its late-night times on October 28, came close to that stretch of nights, which is why she went short and asked what else you had. It proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether you had asked Owen for the draft before entering the zero, you went straight to the next document, so answer that question directly the first time.
